name: CereTax
description: An enterprise-grade, cloud-native tax compliance and automation platform for high-volume businesses. Automates sales, use, and indirect tax calculations across 10,000+ jurisdictions, integrates with major ERPs, and provides audit-ready reporting for digital goods, SaaS, retail, and energy sectors.
features: Real-time multi-jurisdictional tax calculation engine with sub-30ms latency
Enterprise ERP integrations (NetSuite, SAP) and e-commerce connectors
Advanced analytics dashboard with tax trend visualization and audit logs
Rule engine for complex taxability configurations and custom exemptions
Automated audit trail generation with statute references and compliance exports
role: Full-Stack Developer — Built the high-volume analytics dashboard, designed ERP connector integration layers, and engineered the multi-jurisdiction tax rule matrix UI.
challenges: Designing a high-throughput calculation UI that renders thousands of jurisdiction-specific rules without frame drops or calculation delays during peak tax filing periods.
problem: High-volume e-commerce and ERP checkouts required real-time tax calculation across 10,000+ fluctuating US tax jurisdictions without introducing checkout delay or compliance audit risk.
owned: Architected the analytics dashboard, designed ERP connector interfaces, and built the multi-step tax rule configuration UI with client-side state caching.

metrics.headline: Processes 10M+ daily tax transactions; cut compliance reporting latency by 55%

name: EBMCI Taiwan
description: A corporate web platform for Elite BioMedical Corporation Inc. (ebmci.tw), a Taiwan-based medical device solutions company. The platform serves as a comprehensive digital hub for regulatory compliance services, clinical testing documentation, and device licensing workflows for the Asia-Pacific market.
features: Bilingual platform (English/Traditional Chinese) with full i18n support
Regulatory compliance documentation portal with cryptographic verification
Clinical and non-clinical testing service request workflow system
Device licensing progress tracker with milestone status dashboards
Secure client portal for multi-party medical document submission and review
role: Frontend Developer — Developed the bilingual UI, built the client portal, and implemented the documentation management system.
challenges: Implementing accurate Traditional Chinese font rendering and zero-layout-shift bilingual switching while maintaining strict healthcare compliance standards.
problem: Medical device manufacturers lacked a centralized, compliant system to coordinate clinical trial documentation and licensing between English and Traditional Chinese regulatory bodies.
owned: Engineered the full bilingual UI system, built the secure client portal for clinical documentation, and implemented the device licensing progress tracker.

metrics.headline: Serves 150+ medical device audits with 100% compliance across APAC

name: Knowledger
description: An enterprise knowledge management platform that helps organizations and knowledge workers manage, apply, and monetize their intellectual assets. Features AI-powered knowledge discovery, ISO-aligned methodologies, and team collaboration tools.
features: AI-powered knowledge asset discovery, semantic clustering, and categorization
ISO-aligned knowledge management methodology frameworks
Team collaboration workspaces with real-time editing and permission gates
Knowledge performance analytics and ROI measurement dashboards
Enterprise connectors for Slack, Notion, Confluence, and cloud drives
role: Full-Stack Developer — Built the AI vector integration layer, designed the collaboration workspace, and implemented the real-time analytics dashboard.
challenges: Designing a flexible knowledge schema accommodating diverse organizational taxonomies while maintaining sub-100ms vector search latency across dense corpuses.
problem: Enterprise teams were losing proprietary knowledge in fragmented silos, leading to duplicated research and slow onboarding without searchable taxonomy or ROI measurement.
owned: Built the OpenAI vector integration layer, designed the collaborative workspace, and implemented real-time analytics graphs.

metrics.headline: Indexed 50K+ enterprise knowledge assets with sub-100ms semantic search

name: Sarina Clinic
description: A modern, patient-centric website and portal for Sarina Clinic, a general practice in Queensland, Australia. Features online appointment booking via HotDoc integration, service information, bulk billing details, new patient registration, and a patient portal for healthcare information.
features: Online appointment booking with HotDoc integration and instant confirmation
Comprehensive clinical service pages with interactive procedural guides
New patient registration form with digital pre-visit triage questionnaire
Billing information calculator with Medicare rebate estimators
WCAG 2.1 AAA accessible responsive design for elderly and mobile patients
role: Full-Stack Developer — Designed and built the complete website from scratch, integrated HotDoc booking system, and implemented the patient triage portal.
challenges: Ensuring WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance for an elderly patient demographic while maintaining a modern, high-conversion design for online bookings.
problem: Regional clinic phone lines were overwhelmed by routine appointment bookings and Medicare eligibility inquiries, resulting in long patient hold times and missed visits.
owned: Designed and developed the entire web application, integrated the HotDoc appointment booking API, and built the patient intake portal.

metrics.headline: Cut patient check-in & booking time by 60% for 5,000+ registered patients

name: TeacherCool Courses
description: A comprehensive LMS platform offering 200+ courses in Data Science, IT skills, and professional development. Designed for individuals, corporates, and universities, featuring live mentorship, self-paced learning, internship placements, and job-ready certifications.
features: 200+ self-paced courses with lifetime access and granular progress tracking
Live mentorship sessions with industry experts via integrated WebRTC video
Automated internship placement and credential matching system
Cryptographic certificate generation and LinkedIn-shareable verification
Corporate training portal with team progress analytics and completion reports
role: Full-Stack Developer — Built the adaptive video player, student dashboard, payment integration with Razorpay, and automated certificate generation system.
challenges: Building an adaptive video streaming system that could handle thousands of concurrent learners without buffering while optimizing hosting costs.
problem: Legacy LMS systems struggled with high video buffering latency and abandoned checkouts during live batch launches across developing connectivity regions.
owned: Engineered the adaptive video player, student dashboard, Razorpay checkout flow, and automated PDF certification generator.

metrics.headline: Scaled LMS to 200+ courses & 15,000+ active learners with 99.9% uptime

name: WeSellRestaurants
description: A full-featured restaurant brokerage platform connecting buyers and sellers across the US. The platform features specialized listing search, broker tools, franchise opportunities, and the proprietary BOSS (Broker's Operations and Sales System) for managing brokerage sales and operations.
features: Advanced restaurant listing search by geo-coordinates, price range, and cash flow
Broker portal with BOSS system integration for automated sales pipeline management
Franchise opportunity marketplace with buyer financial qualification workflows
Real-time valuation tools, earnings multiplier calculators, and due diligence vaults
Secure document management and legally binding e-signature workflows
role: Full-Stack Developer — Built key sections of the listing platform, broker portal UI, and high-speed geo-search system.
challenges: Implementing complex geo-based spatial search with 14 filter dimensions while maintaining sub-200ms response times across 10,000+ active listings.
problem: Buyers and brokers faced slow, multi-second multi-filter queries across thousands of active franchise restaurant listings, hampering deal flow.
owned: Built key sections of the listing platform, the broker operations UI (BOSS portal), and high-speed geo-filter components.

metrics.headline: Powers 10,000+ brokerage listings across 40+ US states with sub-200ms search

name: iAllo
description: An innovative AI platform that acts as a digital twin for phone communications. It automates hold times, navigates IVR menus, provides real-time transcription, and generates call summaries — available as iOS, Android, web app, and browser extension.
features: AI-powered hold time automation with live human agent voice activity detection
Real-time call audio transcription and AI-generated action item summaries
Visual IVR menu navigation replacing legacy dual-tone voice menus
Team collaboration with shared end-to-end encrypted vaults for business credentials
Chrome extension for one-click calling from any CRM or customer portal
role: Frontend Developer — Built the web dashboard, browser extension UI, call transcription viewer, and real-time audio status indicators.
challenges: Building a browser extension that could seamlessly integrate with any website's phone number links while maintaining zero latency for live WebRTC audio streams.
problem: Users spent an average of 18 minutes on hold navigating opaque IVR phone trees and listening to hold music during critical customer service calls.
owned: Built the web dashboard, browser extension interface, call transcription viewer, and real-time audio status indicators.

metrics.headline: Automated 80% of call hold times using real-time WebRTC audio processing

name: HyeConnect
description: A digital platform connecting Armenians worldwide, enabling community-driven projects, events, and collaboration between the Republic of Armenia and the global diaspora. Co-founded by Alexis Ohanian and Serj Tankian, available on iOS, Android, and Web.
features: Cross-platform mobile app (iOS + Android) with shared React Native codebase
Real-time community feed with groups, initiatives, and collaborative project funding
Diaspora-homeland collaboration tools and verified resource directories
Multi-language support (Armenian, English, Russian) with RTL layout handling
Event discovery and live attendance management system
role: Mobile & Frontend Developer — Developed key screens in the React Native mobile app, built the community feed, and implemented real-time notifications.
challenges: Implementing smooth real-time updates for a global user base across varied network conditions, including low-bandwidth mobile connections.
problem: Dispersed diaspora communities lacked a secure, real-time platform to discover initiatives, fund collaborative projects, and communicate during volatile network periods.
owned: Developed key screens in the React Native mobile app, built the real-time community feed, and implemented push notifications.

metrics.headline: Connected 25,000+ global diaspora members across mobile and web feeds
